dualizing_attachment.orientation_note: Raw ambient-dual frames are not silently equated with the two standard ordered sheet volume forms.
dualizing_attachment.proof: The components of the actual dualized difference remain units modulo the active triple ideals in Ext^3 over S; an R-linear splitting would also split after forgetting to S.

explicit_residue_covectors.scope: Closed integral coefficient covectors on the complete homogeneous Hom complex; no identification with an independently prescribed spatial tangential input.
